code:
$ journalctl -u nginx
Oct 05 09:02:11 web01 systemd[1]: Started A high performance web server.
Oct 05 14:18:03 web01 nginx[1012]: [error] 1012#0: *88 connect() failed (111: Connection refused)
caption: -u filters to the same unit name you'd use with systemctl

eyebrow: Narrow by time, or watch it live
code:
$ journalctl -u nb-sync --since "1 hour ago"
$ journalctl -u nb-sync -f
Oct 05 14:20:02 web01 node[2301]: Sync worker connected to inventory DB
caption: -f follows the journal live, exactly like tail -f on a flat file

eyebrow: Only the errors, from only the current boot
code:
$ journalctl -u nginx -p err
Oct 05 14:18:03 web01 nginx[1012]: [error] 1012#0: *88 connect() failed

$ journalctl -b -1 -u nb-sync
caption: -p filters by minimum severity; -b -1 shows logs from the previous boot
